Goal: Exclude high-contamination routes.

Keep contamination ≤ 0.1.

Implement clean_routes(df).

Check: Only clean routes remain.
step.hint: Drop routes above the ten-percent contamination cap.

step.title: Zone tonnage
step.instructions:
Goal: Compare zones on clean routes.

Return zone,total_tons sorted by zone. Grader applies clean_routes first.

Implement tons_by_zone(df).

Check: Totals match.
step.hint: Add tonnage within each zone.

step.title: Average contamination
step.instructions:
Goal: Citywide contamination average.

Return mean contamination on the raw frame.

Implement avg_contamination(df).

Check: Average to 4 decimals.
step.hint: Average contamination across all routes.
